title: Conversation Action v1
description: The 13 canonical outcomes a conversational turn can resolve into — the authoritative list superseding the Sprint 12 brief's earlier conceptual list. Every meaningful turn maps to exactly one of these via deterministic classification (`classify_action()`), never LLM judgment for this meta-level decision. See docs/bible/14-conversation/README.md and CONV-GOV-020: conversation cannot bypass Designer/JDL validation/Forge by inventing an action outside this set.
